pages.title: Just in Case
pages.text: Equip one of the listed unusual Totems of Undying in your offhand.

pages.title: Just in Case
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Totems have different effects. Read the chosen item tooltip; dying is not required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Spore Bundle releases a one-use harmful slowing cloud at death; it does not revive or cancel elimination.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Exploding Totem rescues its holder and explodes nearby. All trigger through native fatal-damage rescue; deliberate death is not required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Teleporting Totem returns the player to their spawn point. All trigger through native fatal-damage rescue; deliberate death is not required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Skeletal Totem grants the projectile-oriented Sniper effect. All trigger through native fatal-damage rescue; deliberate death is not required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Ghastly Totem grants Levitation, Slow Falling and Fire Resistance. All trigger through native fatal-damage rescue; deliberate death is not required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Stinging Totem summons defensive bees. All trigger through native fatal-damage rescue; deliberate death is not required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Tentacled Totem grants Conduit Power and Cephalopod affecting attackers/targets. All trigger through native fatal-damage rescue; deliberate death is not required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Rotting Totem summons allied zombies and grants Necrosis, changing healing-potion interactions. All trigger through native fatal-damage rescue; deliberate death is not required.
